questions.def: Use 'an' before vowel sounds.
questions.question: I saw ___ interesting movie last night.

questions.def: Use 'an' before words that sound like they start with a vowel.
questions.question: She is ___ honest person.

questions.def: Use 'a' before consonant sounds, even with vowels.
questions.question: He is a university student now.

questions.def: 'An' is needed before 'apple' because of the vowel sound.
questions.question: I want ___ apple. (eat)

questions.def: Use 'a' before singular, countable nouns starting with a consonant sound.
questions.question: They live in ___ small house near the river.

questions.def: Use 'the' for superlatives like 'best'.
questions.question: He is ___ best student in class.

questions.def: If a specific school isn't mentioned, don't use 'the'.
questions.question: She went to a school yesterday morning.

questions.def: Use 'the' for unique landmarks.
questions.question: I saw ___ Eiffel Tower. (visit)

questions.def: No article is needed with uncountable nouns used generally.
questions.question: I like to drink ___ tea in the morning.

questions.def: Use 'the' for something unique like the sun.
questions.question: ___ sun is very bright today.

questions.def: No article with uncountable nouns in general.
questions.question: I want ___ water. (drink)

questions.def: Use 'the' when going to a specific hospital.
questions.question: She went to ___ hospital to visit her friend.

questions.def: Use 'the' with musical instruments.
questions.question: He plays ___ guitar very well.

questions.def: Use 'an' before a vowel sound.
questions.question: I have a idea for the party.

questions.def: 'A' is used before a general profession.
questions.question: She is ___ doctor. (be)

questions.def: Use 'an' before a vowel sound.
questions.question: He is ___ engineer.

questions.def: Use 'the' for something unique.
questions.question: She is ___ only child.

questions.def: Generally, no article is needed for common places like prison.
questions.question: He went to a prison to visit.

questions.def: No article if going to church for religious reasons.
questions.question: They went to ___ church. (go)

questions.def: Use 'a' in exclamations with singular countable nouns.
questions.question: What ___ beautiful day!

questions.def: Use 'a' before consonant sounds even if a word starts with a vowel.
questions.question: He is ___ European.

questions.def: Omit 'a' before uncountable nouns like 'coffee' when used generally.
questions.question: She likes a coffee in the morning.

questions.def: Use 'an' before the adjective 'interesting' due to the vowel sound.
questions.question: I read ___ interesting book.

questions.def: Use 'the' before superlatives.
questions.question: He is ___ tallest boy in the class.

questions.def: Use 'the' with musical instruments.
questions.question: She is learning to play ___ piano.

questions.def: 'A' is correct before 'small island'.
questions.question: He lives on ___ island. (small)

questions.def: Use 'the' for something unique.
questions.question: She is ___ only person who can help.

questions.def: No article needed before plural nouns in general.
questions.question: He likes to read ___ books.

questions.def: Use 'the' for specific places known to both speaker and listener.
questions.question: She went to ___ university after high school.

questions.def: Use 'an' before words that start with a vowel sound.
questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
